name: Kyle Amundson
targetRoleTitle: Director of CRM, Email & SMS Marketing (Luxury eCommerce)
summary: Senior CRM and lifecycle marketing leader specializing in email and SMS retention programs for eCommerce brands. Proven success growing channel revenue, scaling automated lifecycle journeys, and driving repeat purchase behavior through segmentation, personalization, and rigorous testing. Grew SMS from 19% to 44% of sales at Hanna Andersson, while building a trigger and segmentation roadmap that increased conversion and personalized demand. Combines strategic ownership of CRM with hands-on campaign execution, analytics, and people leadership.
coreSkills: Customer Lifetime Value (LTV) & Repeat Purchase Strategy
Email Deliverability & List Management Best Practices
HTML Email Basics & Creative Best Practices

Expanded segmentation from broad batch campaigns to targeted structures (e.g., category-based and behavior-based segments), contributing to a double-digit year-over-year lift in conversion in peak periods.
